slug: 2025-01-13 NADRA powers Somalia's digital transformation with foundational ID infrastructure

facts.fact: NADRA says a Civil Registration Management and Vital Statistics System (CRMVS) was built and handed over to Somali authorities in November 2024, and Somalia is preparing to launch it as part of the SNID project.
